CLINIC GUIDE

Get more from your next clinic visit

A simple checklist for a consultation at Healthy Concept Medical Centre.

Published 21 October 2026 · HCMC information desk

Before your visit, write down the questions you want to ask. Bring identification, a current medication list and any relevant referral letters or test results. If you need help accessing the clinic, discuss this with the team when arranging your appointment.

General doctor consultations start at JA$3,000. Tell the clinic which service you need so the team can explain applicable fees and availability. Tests, treatments and specialist services may have different charges.

We are open Monday to Friday, 8:30 AM–6:00 PM, and Saturday, 9:30 AM–3:00 PM, Jamaica time. Online appointment requests need confirmation from the clinic. Call +1 876 669 5974 if you need help arranging a visit.
